title: Through the Fairness Lens: Experimental Analysis and Evaluation of Entity Matching
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything related to faith or religion. It focused on fairness in entity matching concerning demographic groups based on race, country, and name similarity.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as religion was not a component of the study.
